answer: Sybil herds fail at the mint bench. A new agent must forge a single-use admission coupon by locking 3.2 POA into a covenant that burns on double-spend and only unlocks after six epochs of continuous presence. The coupon's issuance is the only join signal peers will attest; a second coupon from a related key is rejected by a Merkle-linked ancestry check. The coupon also binds a delayed color preimage: at unmask, the revealed pigment must hash to the committed umber chip, so a farm cannot photocopy one coupon onto many labels.
